svg.aria-label: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Setup: Take a palms-up grip wider than your shoulders and let your arms hang long.
svg.title: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Setup: Take a palms-up grip wider than your shoulders and let your arms hang long.

svg.aria-label: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Curl: Curl toward your chest with your upper arms steady and the bar level.
svg.title: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Curl: Curl toward your chest with your upper arms steady and the bar level.

svg.aria-label: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Top: Finish near your chest without leaning back or bringing your elbows forward.
svg.title: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Top: Finish near your chest without leaning back or bringing your elbows forward.

svg.aria-label: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Lower: Lower under control all the way to the start.
svg.title: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl, Lower: Lower under control all the way to the start.
